assumptions: Advisory (fork F6 (a)): the new count never changes the exit code.
The repo slug comes from `gh repo view --json nameWithOwner`, the same repo `gh issue list` reads. The script previously named no repo. A failed lookup abstains (null) instead of exiting 2.
Zero rows means zero rows for THIS repo; a roadmap whose only rows name another repo abstains too.
Only `routed` issues with route `roadmap` are checked; a conflicted issue carrying route:roadmap is already reported as conflicted.
JSON adds two fields beside the partition: `unrowedRoadmap` (number[] | null) and `unrowedRoadmapReason` (string | null).
ROUTE_QUEUE_ROADMAP overrides the roadmap path for tests; the default resolves from the script's location.
